label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Held at 331 for a third consecutive UNGRD balance (Aug 25 and Aug 27, 06:30), the longest the toll has stayed flat since the search-and-rescue window closed.

label: Injured
contestNote: Unchanged in UNGRD's Aug 27 06:30 balance from the Aug 25 figure.

label: Missing
contestNote: Medicina Legal's forensic reconciliation (cross-checking morgue, hospital, shelter and police-station records against the Sistema de Información Red de Desaparecidos y Cadáveres) narrowed active missing-person cases to 152 on Aug 29 — well below UNGRD's Aug 27 06:30 balance of 219. The two agencies use different methodologies and have not formally aligned figures.

label: Structures Destroyed
contestNote: Grew from 33,275 (Aug 25) to 33,395 destroyed / 187,839 damaged-but-standing homes in UNGRD's Aug 27 balance, plus 655 buildings collapsed and 6,372 damaged, across 496 municipios.

label: Departments Affected
contestNote: Holding at 16 departments in UNGRD's Aug 27 06:30 balance, but the municipio count widened again to 496 (from 494 on Aug 25); which department was added beyond Decree 1261's original 15 remains unclarified.

label: Reconstruction Cost Estimate
contestNote: Estimates range from Oxford Economics' $1–2B to USGS's ~$40B (7% of GDP) — a 20x spread. Vice President Restrepo separately estimated Caldas department's reconstruction alone could cost up to COP 1.4 trillion.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
contestNote: New shallow aftershocks continue near the epicentral zone — a six-tremor cluster (M2.4–3.8) near Sipí and Istmina on Aug 28, an eight-tremor sequence (six in Chocó, largest M3.9–4.0) overnight into Aug 29, and a further M3.4 near Istmina before dawn on Aug 30 — though SGC has not published an updated running total since 325+ (Aug 17).
